name: timeline
description: A side pane of session milestones. One small Haiku call per turn adds a row only when the turn had a real outcome, and may suggest one memory to save.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane at session start
autoOpen.description: on opens the timeline pane once per session when the window is at least 144 columns wide. off waits for /timeline.

suggestMemories.title: Suggest memories
suggestMemories.description: on lets the per-turn call suggest one memory in a Save/Skip band, and sends it your memory index so it does not repeat one. off never reads or sends the index.
